name: Mandala Meditation VR
summary:
Mandala Meditation VR is a meditation app that combines the power of music, art and technology to create the most immersive meditation experiences.
‍
MMVR provides Zen meditation training and guided meditations to help you relax or improve focus.

Meditate in Virtual Environments or select a Mandala and give it the colors you want to focus on for your meditation.

We have something for any virtual reality enthusiast seeking a great meditation experience.
‍
Welcome to Mandala Meditation VR.
